## Outcome

Describe the research or engineering outcome, not only the files changed.

## Traceability

- Requirement ID(s):
- Work package/task ID(s):
- ADR/design sections affected:

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover success and failure behavior.
- [ ] Ruff formatting/lint and Pyright pass.
- [ ] Data contracts/configuration/documentation are updated.
- [ ] Data migration or rebuild impact is stated.
- [ ] Temporal leakage and outcome-based selection were considered.
- [ ] Licensing, restricted data, secrets, and logging were reviewed.
- [ ] Performance evidence is included when relevant.
- [ ] Rollback or compatibility path is stated.

## Scope control

- [ ] The change does not add a project non-goal.
- [ ] Material design changes have an ADR.
- [ ] Generated and restricted artifacts are excluded from Git.
